text: Hello Mr. Ruiz, this is Priya from Delta Parts. I’m calling about purchase order two-two-zero. First, the good news: part of your shipment has already left our warehouse. Sixty boxes are in transit now, and I have just sent you the tracking number by email. Please check it. Now, the bad news: the other forty boxes haven’t left yet. A machine stopped at the last minute, and it caused a delay. The production team hasn’t confirmed a new date yet, so I can’t give you a day. I know you need everything by Friday. I will send you an update this afternoon, and I will call you again if there is any change. If you want to reschedule the delivery for next week, please tell me. I’m sorry for the problem. Thank you, and have a good day.
